input_roles.use: governed source definitions, excluded pending, authority gaps
per-item create/modify/delete/reuse, direct/indirect impact and unknown dependencies
assert current ADR; only when candidate ADR_ref was explicitly bound

input_roles.parameters: consumer_code, subject_ref, as_of provided by authorized host

semantics.status_STABLE_requires: explicit current owner decision readback and no unresolved material question, plus no unresolved ADR; never inferred from A2/A3/A4
semantics.adr_not_required_requires: explicit evidence that every material ADR trigger is false
semantics.adr_new_requires: at least one evidenced true trigger and explicit no-current-ADR conclusion from authorized host
semantics.adr_reuse_requires: exact ADR reference and PASS from existing fn_engineering_current_adr_assert_v1
semantics.asof_historical_not_current: HISTORICAL_CONTEXT cannot by itself establish current owner decision
semantics.pending_rules: exclude from approved implementation scope, do not create human decision automatically
semantics.unknown_impacts: keep unresolved evidence gap, do not convert to human decision
semantics.no_user_choice_needed: local reversible implementation details belong to PG-03

fingerprint: sha256 of canonical JSON decision payload excluding decision_fingerprint_sha256
scope: one target decision context; unresolved independent fronts visible, no false READY
